question: For completed migrations, show the average standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of MEMORY_TOTAL by availability zone and instance display name (including subtotals per availability zone and a grand total), and also return (as overall summary values) the total number of system-metadata rows and the average running-sum of instance IDs for instances whose display name is 'forge'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT i.availability_zone AS az,
         i.display_name AS dn,
         m.memory_total AS mt
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT az, dn, STDDEV(mt) AS avg_stddev FROM base GROUP BY az, dn
  UNION ALL
  SELECT az, NULL, STDDEV(mt) FROM base GROUP BY az
  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, NULL, STDDEV(mt) FROM base
),
sys AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM instance_system_metadata),
fr AS (
  SELECT AVG(running_sum) AS avg_running_sum
  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(id) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum
    FROM instances
    WHERE display_name = 'forge'
  ) t
)
SELECT g.az, g.dn, g.avg_stddev, s.c AS system_metadata_rows, f.avg_running_sum
FROM grp g CROSS JOIN sys s CROSS JOIN fr f
ORDER BY g.az, g.dn

  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.availability_zone) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.availability_zone END AS availability_zone,
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.availability_zone) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'

  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.availability_zone, i.display_name
  WITH ROLLUP
),

  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_system_metadata_rows
  FROM instance_system_metadata
),

    SUM(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_id
  FROM instances i
  WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'
),

  SELECT AVG(running_sum_id) AS avg_running_sum_forge
  FROM ForgeRunningSum

  GROUP BY i.availability_zone, i.display_name
